notes:
ULD-360-HP is a portable, 6-channel, 3,600 W "tree-mount" dimmer/relay pack for entertainment lighting (vertical-mount via 1/2" pipe clamp — not rack-mount, so rackUnits is omitted). Leprecon has discontinued all products; leprecon.com now 301-redirects to littlite.com/leprecon, which offers only email support/legacy docs, so no live manufacturer spec page exists. Specs here come from the official Leprecon "ULD Series" user manual (hosted at ManualsLib, sourceUrl) — specifically its "Endplate Illustration – ULD-360DMX-HP" and Specifications sections — corroborated by retailer listings (Markertek P/N 90-06-0270, ProAV Products, Used Lighting, Full Compass).

Connector choices: the manual states factory output-connector options are "stage pin, Nema 5-15 duplex, and Nema L5-20" — none is a perfect match to the given taxonomy (no "stage pin" or twist-lock option exists in it), so this record documents the NEMA 5-15 Duplex variant, the closest clean match. A Stage Pin variant of the ULD-360-HP exists with identical power/DMX I/O but non-standard round stage-pin output connectors not representable in the given connector list. Each physical "duplex" receptacle (2 sockets) per channel is modeled as a single output port.

Power input: the manual explicitly states the HP model is "15 Amps per line cord (30 amps total capacity)" via two separate line cords (Line A / Line B), each terminating in a standard NEMA 5-15 plug — consistent with the commonly quoted 3,600 W total (2 × 15 A × 120 V). One retailer (Markertek) instead lists "2 Nema 5-20" connectors / 20 A breakers for the same SKU; this discrepancy with the manual could not be resolved from available sources and may reflect a running product change or listing error. Single-breaker-per-line design; no individual per-channel fuses/breakers.

DMX In/Out confirmed in the manual as standard 5-pin XLR (DMX512). No connector in this device qualifies for a bandwidth "grade" under the given rules (power, DMX/XLR5, and Edison-style connectors are outside the graded SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet families), so grade is omitted on all ports. Physical size/weight (from ProAV Products listing, medium confidence): approx. 15.9" H x 5.85" W x 4.1" D, 12 lb.
